forgetting_mechanism: Unchanged. The rescue scan explicitly excludes tombstoned records (WHERE record_id NOT IN (SELECT record_id FROM tombstones)) and is unreachable whenever decision.touched_deleted is set, so deleted content cannot be recovered by the second-chance path -- F stays 0.
